title: The greenhouse after rain
alt: A glasshouse railway changes from daylight to rainy blue hour with illuminated carriages and wet reflections.
description: A weather and lighting edit retains the scene layout, train and human subject while changing the atmosphere.

frames.label: Input
frames.alt: A green train curves through giant orchids and ferns above a glass platform.
frames.prompt: An intricate, elegant fantasy conservatory built around a tiny elevated railway. A single dark-green passenger train follows a connected curved brass track through giant white orchids, layered fern fronds and translucent glass walkways. The track has continuous supporting columns and passes through a clearly open arched station before bending toward the background. A mature woman in a pale linen dress stands on the near station platform holding a closed yellow umbrella, with natural proportions. Sophisticated architectural model photography, diffused daylight, botanical detail, brass, ivory and emerald palette, deep coherent perspective, no lettering.

frames.label: Result
frames.alt: A glasshouse railway changes from daylight to rainy blue hour with illuminated carriages and wet reflections.
frames.prompt: Edit this exact scene into a rainy blue-hour evening. Keep the train, track path, station platform, glasshouse architecture, orchids and the person in exactly the same positions with the same designs. Add convincing raindrops to the glass panes, damp reflective surfaces and a soft blue exterior. Turn on warm lights inside the train and along the platform, with coherent reflections. Preserve all geometry and object identities; only weather, time of day and lighting change. No new text.
